§6Heat Sink§f

§aKeeps your reactor from melting down.§f
Heat Sinks are placed inside a Solid Fission Reactor to absorb heat from adjacent fuel cells. Each type has a specific cooling rate and placement rule. Water Sinks cool at §b55 H/t§f and need exactly one adjacent chamber. Iron Sinks do §b50 H/t§f. Redstone Sinks hit §b85 H/t§f.

The best coolers have strict adjacency requirements. Diamond Sinks cool at §b200 H/t§f but need specific neighboring blocks. Plan your layout carefully.

§cWARNING:§f Not enough cooling means meltdown. Always calculate your heat budget before powering on.

§ePS:§f Check the placement rules in JEI. Each cooler type has different adjacency requirements.
